status_note: Rejected at Roc's gate 2026-08-04. Kept on record, not deleted.
learn_source: Watch the priest steady the arch lanterns against the evening wind at the Festival Grounds — the rite fails if the flames won't hold
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on something the wind is troubling once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the calm holds long and wide; at baseline it is a small pocket that the next gust ends. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: guttering in wind, the flame steadies upright; already burning steady in shelter, nothing changes
The surface flattens to a mirror until something touches it
Falls slack mid-flap and hangs dead straight while the calm lasts
no_effect — it was not moving; there is nothing to still
No physical effect — living receivers never catch; the bird is not stilled
receivers.reaction_kind: freeze, head-cock at the sudden quiet air, then bustles off
